correctness.rationale: Lemma 2.2 (arXiv:2212.05871) gives the 27 edge-endpoint closed-neighborhood generators. A complete 1107-face enumeration yields (18,135,396,369,162,27). Each of 422 bitmask-encoded collapse pairs is independently verified to be a genuine free face with unique remaining proper superface; the surviving (18,109,136) two-complex has a certified 17-edge spanning tree, and 92 triangular van Kampen relators each kill exactly one previously nontrivial non-tree generator. Its fundamental group is trivial. Integral H2 is free of rank Euler characteristic minus one, 44, and integral Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead proves the asserted wedge, not just mod-two ranks. Girth six is checked with an explicit six-cycle and exhaustive edge-deletion shortest-path tests. The pure five-dimensional complex with nonzero H2 cannot be shellable. All steps replay from included files.

value.rationale: The 18-vertex Pappus graph is a canonical incidence graph of girth six. The scale-three Čech nerve is the first scale outside the r<girth/2 reconstruction guarantee in the primary graph Čech paper. The exact integral homotopy type and constructively certified non-shellability provide motivated structure at a natural threshold, not a trivial normalization or a known-table recopy. This finite exact classification does not purport to solve arbitrary cubic graphs or full persistent homology.
